gaps.gap: Cross-task collective intelligence factors do not identify causal protocols
gaps.testable_need: factorial manipulation of communication, aggregation, and feedback

gaps.gap: Functional diversity is often proxied rather than measured
gaps.testable_need: representation, heuristic, error-correlation, and search-coverage metrics

gaps.gap: Human-AI groups may gain accuracy while losing independent human contribution
gaps.testable_need: first-independent-answer, correction, abstention, and influence metrics

gaps.gap: Social influence can reduce diversity and inflate confidence
Average group performance hides dominance and minority suppression
gaps.testable_need: turn-taking, dissent survival, and subgroup trajectory analysis

handoff: Use a causal human-only, AI-only, and hybrid benchmark with held-out task families.
